classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is grains. Parent scope: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients). Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.grains.bread_bakery: Bread, rolls and pastries; excludes packaged sweet biscuits.
criteria.grains.dry_staples: Uncooked rice, pasta and breakfast cereals; excludes prepared meals.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
